transformation: Exact documented privacy substitutions and a two-line inert prefix on Python only; original body and original inert fences retained.
prefix:
# ANALYSIS EXPORT ONLY; privacy placeholders are unbound.
raise SystemExit("INERT_PUBLIC_ANALYSIS_NO_EXECUTION_AUTHORITY")
placeholders: All PRIVATE_* strings and identifiers are unbound analysis placeholders, including paths, UID/inode, unit prefixes, assignment and original dependency pins. They are not usable configuration.
preserved_constants: Time/resource budgets, mathematical factors, root UID semantics, permissions, descriptor numbers, protocol names and synthetic control identities retain their source meaning.
authority: Source manifest is an exported historical source body, not an index of public hashes or activation manifest. source-index.json and MANIFEST.json alone identify public bytes.
inverse: Private per-file inverse map plus recorded prefix restores every exact original byte; map and original private paths are not published.
excluded: Raw results, private handoffs, transcripts, credentials, runtime grants/receipts, native identities, mutable successor and full third-party source.
source_review: Rejected source remains rejected. Export syntax/hash/privacy checks do not retest or accept its algorithms.
